content: धृष् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (धर्षति, धर्षित) .²1 To come together, be compact. .²2 To hurt or injure. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (धर्षति, धर्षयति-ते) .²1 To offend, hurt, injure. .²2 To insult, treat with indignity. .²3 To assail, overcome, overpower, conquer, destroy. .²4 To dare to attack, challenge, defy. .²5 To violate or outrage (as a woman). --III. €5 <ab>P.</ab> (धृष्णोति, धृष्ट) .²1 To be bold or courageous; ते ह ब्राह्मणा न दधृषुः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 To be confident. .²3 To be proud or overbearing. .²4 To be impudent or impatient. .²5 To dare, venture (with <ab>inf.</ab>) .²6 To brave, challenge; प्रहस्तस्य पुरोमात्यान् जिहिंसुर्दधृषुस्तथा (वानराः) <ls>Bk. 14. 102</ls>. .²7 To insult, treat with contumely. --IV. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (धर्षयते) To assail, attack, outrage.
